title.sk: Tacos s kuracou tingou
title.en: Chicken tinga tacos

description.sk: Natrhané kuracie mäso v údenej paradajkovej omáčke s cibuľou, v tortillách s avokádom a smotanou.
description.en: Shredded chicken in a smoky tomato and onion sauce, in tortillas with avocado and sour cream.

steps.sk: Kuracie prsia vlož do hrnca s bobkovým listom, polovicou cibule a ½ lyžičky soli, zalej vodou a var na miernom ohni 15 minút. Nechaj ich 5 minút vo vode dôjsť (74 °C), potom ich vyber a dvoma vidličkami natrhaj na vlákna. 200 ml vývaru si nechaj.
steps.en: Put the chicken breasts in a pan with the bay leaf, half an onion and ½ teaspoon of salt, cover with water and simmer gently for 15 minutes. Leave them in the water for 5 minutes more (74 °C), then lift out and shred with two forks. Keep 200 ml of the broth.

steps.sk: Zvyšnú cibuľu nakrájaj na tenké polkolieska a opekaj ju na oleji 6 minút, kým nezmäkne a nezačne hnednúť. Pridaj prelisovaný cesnak, údenú papriku, čili, rímsky kmín a oregano a miešaj 30 sekúnd.
steps.en: Slice the remaining onion thinly and fry it in the oil for 6 minutes until soft and starting to brown. Add the crushed garlic, smoked paprika, chilli powder, cumin and oregano and stir for 30 seconds.

steps.sk: Pridaj paradajky, zvyšnú soľ a 200 ml vývaru a var 8 minút do hustej omáčky. Vmiešaj natrhané mäso a var ďalšie 3 minúty, kým omáčku nenasaje.
steps.en: Add the tomatoes, remaining salt and 200 ml of the broth and simmer for 8 minutes into a thick sauce. Stir in the shredded chicken and simmer for 3 more minutes until it soaks up the sauce.

steps.sk: Avokádo nakrájaj na plátky a pokvapkaj limetkou, kapustu nakrájaj na tenučké rezance. Tortilly zohrej na suchej panvici 20 sekúnd z každej strany, kým nie sú mäkké a pružné.
steps.en: Slice the avocado and squeeze over some lime; shred the cabbage finely. Warm the tortillas in a dry frying pan for 20 seconds on each side until soft and pliable.

steps.sk: Na tortillu daj tingu, kapustu, avokádo, lyžicu kyslej smotany a koriander a pokvapkaj limetkou. Tinga vydrží v chladničke 4 dni a hodí sa aj do quesadíl alebo na ryžu.
steps.en: Fill each tortilla with tinga, cabbage, avocado, a spoonful of sour cream and coriander and finish with a squeeze of lime. The tinga keeps in the fridge for 4 days and is great in quesadillas or on rice.

title.sk: Mexická tortillová polievka s kuracím
title.en: Mexican chicken tortilla soup

description.sk: Pikantná paradajková polievka s kuracím, fazuľou a kukuricou, s chrumkavými prúžkami tortíl a avokádom.
description.en: A spicy tomato soup with chicken, beans and corn, topped with crispy tortilla strips and avocado.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 200 °C. Tortilly nakrájaj na prúžky široké 1 cm, premiešaj s lyžicou oleja a štipkou soli a peč na plechu 8 až 10 minút dochrumkava.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Cut the tortillas into 1 cm strips, toss with a tablespoon of oil and a pinch of salt and bake on a tray for 8 to 10 minutes until crisp.

steps.sk: V hrnci rozohrej zvyšný olej a nadrobno nakrájanú cibuľu na ňom speň 5 minút. Pridaj cesnak, rímsky kmín, údenú papriku a čili a miešaj 30 sekúnd, potom pridaj paradajky a var 5 minút.
steps.en: Heat the remaining oil in a pot and soften the finely chopped onion for 5 minutes. Add the garlic, cumin, smoked paprika and chilli powder and stir for 30 seconds, then add the tomatoes and simmer for 5 minutes.

steps.sk: Prilej 1 liter vody s rozdrobeným bujónom, vlož celé kuracie prsia a var na miernom ohni 15 minút, kým nemajú vnútri 74 °C. Mäso vyber a natrhaj vidličkami na vlákna.
steps.en: Pour in 1 litre of water with the crumbled stock cube, add the whole chicken breasts and simmer gently for 15 minutes until 74 °C inside. Lift out the chicken and shred it with forks.

steps.sk: Do polievky pridaj scedenú fazuľu, kukuricu a natrhané mäso a var 5 minút. Dochuť limetkovou šťavou.
steps.en: Add the drained beans, sweetcorn and shredded chicken to the soup and simmer for 5 minutes. Season with lime juice.

steps.sk: Rozlej do misiek a navrch daj chrumkavé prúžky tortíl, kocky avokáda, strúhaný čedar a koriander. Polievka bez oblohy vydrží v chladničke 3 dni; prúžky pridávaj až pri podávaní.
steps.en: Ladle into bowls and top with the crispy tortilla strips, diced avocado, grated cheddar and coriander. Without the toppings the soup keeps in the fridge for 3 days; add the strips only when serving.

title.sk: Rybie tacos s limetkovým kapustovým šalátom
title.en: Fish tacos with lime slaw

description.sk: Korenistá opečená biela ryba v tortillách s chrumkavou červenou kapustou a jogurtovou omáčkou.
description.en: Spiced pan-fried white fish in tortillas with crunchy red cabbage slaw and a yogurt sauce.

steps.sk: Kapustu nakrájaj na tenučké rezance, premiešaj ju so šťavou z jednej limetky a ¼ lyžičky soli a nechaj 10 minút zmäknúť. Jogurt zmiešaj s majonézou, srirachou a lyžicou limetkovej šťavy.
steps.en: Shred the cabbage finely, toss it with the juice of one lime and ¼ teaspoon of salt and leave it to soften for 10 minutes. Mix the yogurt with the mayonnaise, sriracha and a tablespoon of lime juice.

steps.sk: Rybu osuš a nakrájaj na prsty široké 3 cm. Múku zmiešaj s rímskym kmínom, údenou paprikou, cesnakovým práškom a zvyšnou soľou a rybu v nej obaľ.
steps.en: Pat the fish dry and cut it into 3 cm fingers. Mix the flour with the cumin, smoked paprika, garlic powder and remaining salt and coat the fish in it.

steps.sk: Na panvici rozohrej olej na stredne silnom ohni a rybu opekaj 2 až 3 minúty z každej strany, kým nie je zlatistá a ľahko sa oddeľuje na lupienky. Obracaj ju opatrne obracačkou, je krehká.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a frying pan over a medium-high heat and fry the fish for 2 to 3 minutes on each side until golden and flaking easily. Turn it carefully with a spatula, as it is delicate.

steps.sk: Tortilly zohrej na suchej panvici 20 sekúnd z každej strany. Avokádo nakrájaj na plátky.
steps.en: Warm the tortillas in a dry frying pan for 20 seconds on each side. Slice the avocado.

steps.sk: Na tortillu daj kapustový šalát, rybu, avokádo, lyžicu jogurtovej omáčky a koriander a pokvapkaj limetkou. Rybie tacos jedz hneď; kapustový šalát vydrží v chladničke 2 dni.
steps.en: Fill each tortilla with slaw, fish, avocado, a spoonful of yogurt sauce and coriander and squeeze over some lime. Eat the tacos straight away; the slaw keeps in the fridge for 2 days.

title.sk: Vegánske chili sin carne s batátmi
title.en: Vegan chilli sin carne with sweet potato

description.sk: Husté chili z dvoch druhov fazule, batátov a sójového granulátu s údenou paprikou a kakaom.
description.en: A thick chilli of two kinds of beans, sweet potato and soy mince with smoked paprika and cocoa.

steps.sk: Sójový granulát zalej 300 ml vriacej vody s rozdrobeným bujónom, nechaj 10 minút napučať a potom ho vytlač. Cibuľu a papriky nakrájaj na kocky, batáty ošúp a nakrájaj na kocky s hranou 2 cm a cesnak nadrobno.
steps.en: Pour 300 ml boiling water with the crumbled stock cube over the soy mince, leave it to swell for 10 minutes, then squeeze it dry. Dice the onions and peppers, peel the sweet potatoes and cut them into 2 cm cubes and chop the garlic finely.

steps.sk: Vo veľkom hrnci rozohrej olej a cibuľu s paprikami na ňom opekaj 6 minút. Pridaj granulát a opekaj ďalšie 4 minúty, kým nezačne hnednúť, potom pridaj cesnak, všetky koreniny a kakao a miešaj minútu.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a large pot and fry the onions and peppers for 6 minutes. Add the soy mince and fry for another 4 minutes until it starts to brown, then add the garlic, all the spices and the cocoa and stir for a minute.

steps.sk: Pridaj pretlak, paradajky, batáty, scedenú fazuľu, soľ a 300 ml vody a priveď do varu. Var prikryté na miernom ohni 25 minút a občas premiešaj, kým batáty nie sú mäkké a chili husté.
steps.en: Add the tomato paste, tomatoes, sweet potatoes, drained beans, salt and 300 ml water and bring to the boil. Simmer, covered, over a low heat for 25 minutes, stirring now and then, until the sweet potatoes are tender and the chilli thick.

steps.sk: Medzitým uvar ryžu so 600 ml vody pod pokrievkou 15 minút. Chili dochuť limetkovou šťavou – kakao a údená paprika mu dajú hĺbku, akú má verzia s mäsom.
steps.en: Meanwhile, cook the rice with 600 ml water, covered, for 15 minutes. Season the chilli with lime juice; the cocoa and smoked paprika give it the depth of a meat version.

steps.sk: Podávaj s ryžou, posypané koriandrom. Chili je ideálne na varenie do zásoby: v chladničke vydrží 5 dní a v mrazničke 3 mesiace.
steps.en: Serve with the rice, scattered with coriander. Chilli is ideal for batch cooking: it keeps in the fridge for 5 days and in the freezer for 3 months.

title.sk: Arroz rojo – mexická červená ryža s fazuľou a vajcom
title.en: Arroz rojo: Mexican red rice with beans and a fried egg

description.sk: Ryža opečená a uvarená v paradajkovom pyré, s čiernou fazuľou a volským okom.
description.en: Rice toasted and simmered in tomato purée, with black beans and a fried egg.

steps.sk: Paradajky, cibuľu a cesnak rozmixuj so 400 ml vody na hladké pyré. Ryžu prepláchni a nechaj dôkladne odkvapkať, mrkvu nakrájaj na drobné kocky.
steps.en: Blend the tomatoes, onion and garlic with 400 ml water into a smooth purée. Rinse the rice and let it drain thoroughly; dice the carrot small.

steps.sk: V širokom hrnci rozohrej 2 lyžice oleja a ryžu na ňom opekaj za stáleho miešania 5 minút, kým zrnká nie sú zlatisté a orieškovo nevoňajú – tak bude ryža sypká.
steps.en: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a wide pan and toast the rice, stirring constantly, for 5 minutes until the grains are golden and smell nutty; this keeps it fluffy.

steps.sk: Vlej paradajkové pyré, pridaj rozdrobený bujón, rímsky kmín, soľ a mrkvu, priveď do varu, prikry a var na najmenšom ohni 15 minút. Potom pridaj hrášok, prikry a nechaj 5 minút dôjsť mimo ohňa.
steps.en: Pour in the tomato purée, add the crumbled stock cube, cumin, salt and carrot, bring to the boil, cover and cook on the lowest heat for 15 minutes. Then add the peas, cover and leave off the heat for 5 minutes.

steps.sk: Fazuľu prehrej v malom hrnci s 3 lyžicami vody a časť z nej roztlač vidličkou. Na zvyšnom oleji vypráž volské oká 3 minúty, kým bielky stuhnú.
steps.en: Warm the beans in a small pan with 3 tablespoons of water and mash some of them with a fork. Fry the eggs in the remaining oil for 3 minutes until the whites set.

steps.sk: Ryžu prečechraj vidličkou a podávaj s fazuľou a vajcom, posypanú koriandrom, s mesiačikom limetky. Ryža s fazuľou vydrží v chladničke 4 dni; vajcia pripravuj čerstvé.
steps.en: Fluff up the rice with a fork and serve with the beans and egg, scattered with coriander and with a lime wedge. The rice and beans keep in the fridge for 4 days; fry the eggs fresh.

title.sk: Chilaquiles s červenou salsou a vajcom
title.en: Chilaquiles rojos with fried eggs

description.sk: Chrumkavé kúsky tortíl v pikantnej paradajkovej salse s volským okom, syrom a smotanou.
description.en: Crisp tortilla pieces tossed in a spicy tomato salsa with fried eggs, cheese and sour cream.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 200 °C. Tortilly nakrájaj na osminky, premiešaj s lyžicou oleja a peč na plechu 10 minút, kým nie sú chrumkavé ako čipsy.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Cut the tortillas into eighths, toss with a tablespoon of oil and bake on a tray for 10 minutes until crisp like chips.

steps.sk: Paradajky rozmixuj s cibuľou, cesnakom, čili papričkou, rímskym kmínom a soľou. Na panvici rozohrej lyžičku oleja, vlej salsu (pozor, strieka) a var 8 minút, kým nezhustne.
steps.en: Blend the tomatoes with the onion, garlic, chilli, cumin and salt. Heat a teaspoon of oil in a frying pan, pour in the salsa (it spits) and simmer for 8 minutes until thickened.

steps.sk: Do salsy pridaj chrumkavé tortilly a premiešaj ich, aby boli obalené, ale miestami zostali chrumkavé. Hneď odstav – dlhým varom by zmäkli na kašu.
steps.en: Add the crisp tortillas to the salsa and toss to coat, leaving some edges crunchy. Take it off the heat straight away; longer cooking turns them to mush.

steps.sk: Na inej panvici vypráž volské oká na zvyšnom oleji 3 minúty. Červenú cibuľu nakrájaj na tenké kolieska.
steps.en: In another pan, fry the eggs in the remaining oil for 3 minutes. Slice the red onion into thin rings.

steps.sk: Chilaquiles rozdeľ na taniere, navrch daj vajcia, rozdrobenú fetu, kyslú smotanu, cibuľu a koriander. V Mexiku sú to obľúbené raňajky; jedz ich hneď, kým sú tortilly chrumkavé.
steps.en: Divide the chilaquiles between plates and top with the eggs, crumbled feta, sour cream, onion and coriander. In Mexico they are a favourite breakfast; eat them at once while the tortillas are crisp.

title.sk: Burrito s morčacím mäsom, ryžou a fazuľou
title.en: Turkey, rice and bean burritos

description.sk: Veľké zrolované tortilly s korenistým morčacím, limetkovou ryžou, fazuľou a syrom – ideálne do mrazničky.
description.en: Big rolled tortillas with spiced turkey, lime rice, beans and cheese; ideal for the freezer.

steps.sk: Ryžu prepláchni a var s 300 ml vody a štipkou soli pod pokrievkou 15 minút; potom do nej vmiešaj šťavu z polovice limetky. Cibuľu a papriku nakrájaj na drobné kocky.
steps.en: Rinse the rice and cook it with 300 ml water and a pinch of salt, covered, for 15 minutes, then stir in the juice of half the lime. Dice the onion and pepper small.

steps.sk: Na panvici rozohrej olej a cibuľu s paprikou na ňom opekaj 4 minúty. Pridaj mäso a opekaj ho 6 minút, hrudky rozbíjaj, kým nie je celé biele a nezačína hnednúť.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a frying pan and fry the onion and pepper for 4 minutes. Add the turkey and fry for 6 minutes, breaking up the lumps, until it is white all over and starting to brown.

steps.sk: Vmiešaj cesnak, všetky koreniny, pretlak a zvyšnú soľ, pridaj scedenú fazuľu a 100 ml vody a var 5 minút, kým zmes nie je šťavnatá, ale nie tekutá. Morčacie je hotové pri 74 °C.
steps.en: Stir in the garlic, all the spices, the tomato paste and remaining salt, add the drained beans and 100 ml water and simmer for 5 minutes until juicy but not runny. The turkey is done at 74 °C.

steps.sk: Tortilly zohrej, aby boli pružné. Do stredu každej daj ryžu, mäsovú zmes, strúhaný čedar a lyžicu jogurtu, prehni spodný okraj, potom boky a pevne zroluj.
steps.en: Warm the tortillas so they are pliable. Spoon rice, the turkey mixture, grated cheddar and a spoonful of yogurt into the middle of each, fold up the bottom, then the sides, and roll up tightly.

steps.sk: Burritá opeč na suchej panvici spojom nadol 2 minúty z každej strany dozlatista. Zabalené do alobalu vydržia v chladničke 3 dni, zamrazené 2 mesiace; prehreješ ich v rúre alebo mikrovlnke.
steps.en: Toast the burritos seam side down in a dry frying pan for 2 minutes on each side until golden. Wrapped in foil they keep for 3 days in the fridge or 2 months in the freezer; reheat in the oven or microwave.

title.sk: Lomo saltado – peruánske hovädzie s hranolkami
title.en: Lomo saltado: Peruvian beef stir-fry with fries

description.sk: Prúžky hovädzieho prudko opečené s cibuľou, paradajkami a sójovou omáčkou, premiešané s hranolkami.
description.en: Strips of beef seared with onion, tomatoes and soy sauce, tossed with fries.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 220 °C. Zemiaky nakrájaj na hranolky hrubé 1 cm, osuš ich, premiešaj s lyžicou oleja a polovicou soli a peč na plechu 30 minút, v polovici ich obráť. Ryžu prepláchni a var so 400 ml vody pod pokrievkou 15 minút.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 220 °C. Cut the potatoes into 1 cm fries, dry them, toss with a tablespoon of oil and half the salt and bake on a tray for 30 minutes, turning halfway. Rinse the rice and cook it with 400 ml water, covered, for 15 minutes.

steps.sk: Mäso nakrájaj na prúžky hrubé 1 cm, posoľ zvyšnou soľou, okoreň a posyp rímskym kmínom. Cibuľu nakrájaj na hrubé mesiačiky, paradajky na osminky bez semien a čili na tenké prúžky.
steps.en: Cut the beef into 1 cm strips and season with the remaining salt, the pepper and the cumin. Cut the onions into thick wedges, the tomatoes into deseeded eighths and the chilli into thin strips.

steps.sk: Vo woku alebo veľkej panvici rozpáľ lyžicu oleja na najsilnejšom ohni a mäso opekaj v dvoch dávkach 2 minúty, kým nie je zvonka hnedé a vnútri ružové. Vyber ho.
steps.en: Heat a tablespoon of oil in a wok or large frying pan over the highest heat and sear the beef in two batches for 2 minutes until browned outside and pink inside. Lift it out.

steps.sk: Na zvyšnom oleji opekaj cibuľu, cesnak a čili 2 minúty, aby cibuľa zostala chrumkavá. Pridaj paradajky, vráť mäso, prilej sójovú omáčku a ocot a prehadzuj 1 minútu, kým nevznikne šťavnatá omáčka.
steps.en: Stir-fry the onions, garlic and chilli in the remaining oil for 2 minutes so the onions stay crunchy. Add the tomatoes, return the beef, pour in the soy sauce and vinegar and toss for 1 minute into a juicy sauce.

steps.sk: Odstav, vmiešaj hranolky a koriander – hranolky čiastočne nasajú omáčku, tak sa lomo saltado v Peru je. Podávaj hneď s ryžou.
steps.en: Take it off the heat and fold in the fries and coriander; the fries soak up some of the sauce, which is how lomo saltado is eaten in Peru. Serve straight away with the rice.

title.sk: Peruánske pečené kurča so zelenou omáčkou
title.en: Peruvian roast chicken thighs with green sauce

description.sk: Kuracie stehná v marináde z cesnaku, kmínu a údenej papriky upečené so zemiakmi, s koriandrovou omáčkou.
description.en: Chicken thighs marinated in garlic, cumin and smoked paprika, roasted with potatoes and served with coriander sauce.

steps.sk: Cesnak roztlač s ¾ lyžičky soli na pastu a zmiešaj s rímskym kmínom, údenou paprikou, oreganom, korením, sójovou omáčkou, šťavou z jednej limetky a 2 lyžicami oleja. Stehná v marináde obaľ a nechaj aspoň 30 minút v chladničke.
steps.en: Crush the garlic with ¾ teaspoon of salt to a paste and mix with the cumin, smoked paprika, oregano, pepper, soy sauce, the juice of one lime and 2 tablespoons of oil. Coat the thighs and marinate in the fridge for at least 30 minutes.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 220 °C. Zemiaky nakrájaj na mesiačiky, premiešaj so zvyšným olejom a štipkou soli a rozlož ich do pekáča. Stehná polož navrch.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 220 °C. Cut the potatoes into wedges, toss with the remaining oil and a pinch of salt and spread them in a roasting dish. Lay the thighs on top.

steps.sk: Peč 35 až 40 minút, kým kurča nie je tmavozlaté s chrumkavými okrajmi a vnútri nemá 74 °C a zemiaky sú mäkké. V polovici zemiaky premiešaj.
steps.en: Roast for 35 to 40 minutes until the chicken is deep golden with crisp edges and 74 °C inside and the potatoes are tender. Stir the potatoes halfway.

steps.sk: Na zelenú omáčku rozmixuj koriandrovú vňať, čili papričku, majonézu, jogurt, šťavu z druhej limetky a zvyšnú soľ na hladkú, sviežo zelenú omáčku.
steps.en: For the green sauce, blend the coriander, chilli, mayonnaise, yogurt, the juice of the second lime and the remaining salt into a smooth, bright green sauce.

steps.sk: Podávaj kurča so zemiakmi a zelenou omáčkou. Mäso aj omáčka vydržia v chladničke 3 dni, takže sa hodia do krabičiek.
steps.en: Serve the chicken with the potatoes and green sauce. Both the chicken and sauce keep in the fridge for 3 days, so they pack well for lunches.

title.sk: Moqueca – brazílsky rybací guláš s kokosovým mliekom
title.en: Moqueca: Brazilian fish stew with coconut milk

description.sk: Biela ryba dusená vo vrstvách s paprikou, paradajkami a koriandrom v kokosovom mlieku s limetkou.
description.en: White fish layered with peppers, tomatoes and coriander and simmered in coconut milk with lime.

steps.sk: Rybu nakrájaj na veľké kusy (5 cm), posoľ ½ lyžičky soli, pokvapkaj šťavou z jednej limetky, pridaj prelisovaný cesnak a nechaj 15 minút marinovať. Ryžu prepláchni a var s 500 ml vody pod pokrievkou 15 minút.
steps.en: Cut the fish into large 5 cm pieces, season with ½ teaspoon of salt, squeeze over the juice of one lime, add the crushed garlic and marinate for 15 minutes. Rinse the rice and cook it with 500 ml water, covered, for 15 minutes.

steps.sk: Cibuľu, papriky a paradajky nakrájaj na tenké kolieska a čili nadrobno. V širokom hrnci rozohrej olej a cibuľu s paprikou na ňom opekaj 5 minút, kým nezmäknú.
steps.en: Slice the onion, peppers and tomatoes into thin rings and chop the chilli finely. Heat the oil in a wide pan and soften the onion and peppers for 5 minutes.

steps.sk: Polovicu paradajok rozlož na zeleninu, navrch polož rybu aj s marinádou a prikry ju zvyšnými paradajkami, čili a polovicou koriandra. Zalej kokosovým mliekom a posyp paprikou a zvyšnou soľou.
steps.en: Lay half the tomatoes over the vegetables, put the fish and its marinade on top and cover with the remaining tomatoes, the chilli and half the coriander. Pour over the coconut milk and sprinkle with the paprika and remaining salt.

steps.sk: Priveď do mierneho varu, prikry a var 12 až 15 minút bez miešania, len hrncom občas jemne zatras. Ryba je hotová, keď je biela a ľahko sa oddeľuje na lupienky.
steps.en: Bring to a gentle simmer, cover and cook for 12 to 15 minutes without stirring, just giving the pan a gentle shake now and then. The fish is done when white and flaking easily.

steps.sk: Dochuť šťavou z druhej limetky, posyp zvyšným koriandrom a podávaj s ryžou. Moqueca je najlepšia čerstvá; ohrievaná ryba sa rozpadá.
steps.en: Season with the juice of the second lime, scatter with the remaining coriander and serve with the rice. Moqueca is best fresh; reheated fish falls apart.

title.sk: Kubánske picadillo s ryžou
title.en: Cuban picadillo with rice

description.sk: Mleté hovädzie s paradajkami, zemiakmi, olivami a hrozienkami – sladkoslané kubánske domáce jedlo.
description.en: Minced beef with tomatoes, potatoes, olives and raisins; sweet and savoury Cuban home cooking.

steps.sk: Zemiaky ošúp a nakrájaj na kocky s hranou 1 cm, cibuľu a papriku nadrobno a cesnak prelisuj. Ryžu prepláchni a var s 500 ml vody pod pokrievkou 15 minút.
steps.en: Peel the potatoes and cut them into 1 cm dice, chop the onion and pepper finely and crush the garlic. Rinse the rice and cook it with 500 ml water, covered, for 15 minutes.

steps.sk: V širokej panvici rozohrej olej a zemiaky opekaj 6 minút, kým nie sú zlatisté. Pridaj cibuľu a papriku a opekaj ďalšie 4 minúty.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a wide frying pan and fry the potatoes for 6 minutes until golden. Add the onion and pepper and fry for another 4 minutes.

steps.sk: Pridaj mäso a opekaj 6 minút, hrudky rozbíjaj, kým nie je hnedé. Vmiešaj cesnak, rímsky kmín, oregano a pretlak a miešaj minútu.
steps.en: Add the beef and fry for 6 minutes, breaking up the lumps, until browned. Stir in the garlic, cumin, oregano and tomato paste and cook for a minute.

steps.sk: Pridaj paradajky, olivy, hrozienka, bobkový list, ocot, soľ a 100 ml vody a var odkryté 12 minút, kým omáčka nezhustne a zemiaky nie sú mäkké. Hovädzie je hotové pri 71 °C.
steps.en: Add the tomatoes, olives, raisins, bay leaf, vinegar, salt and 100 ml water and simmer uncovered for 12 minutes until the sauce thickens and the potatoes are tender. The beef is done at 71 °C.

steps.sk: Podávaj s ryžou. Sladké hrozienka a slané olivy sú pre picadillo typické. V chladničke vydrží 4 dni a dá sa zamraziť; zvyšky sa hodia aj do tacos alebo plnených paprík.
steps.en: Serve with the rice. Sweet raisins and salty olives are what make picadillo. It keeps in the fridge for 4 days and freezes well; leftovers are good in tacos or stuffed peppers.

title.sk: Empanadas s hovädzím, olivami a vajcom
title.en: Beef empanadas with olives and egg

description.sk: Polmesiačiky z lístkového cesta plnené korenistým hovädzím, olivami a vajcom natvrdo.
description.en: Puff pastry half-moons filled with spiced beef, olives and hard-boiled egg.

steps.sk: Cibuľu a papriku nakrájaj na drobné kocky a na oleji ich speň 6 minút. Pridaj mäso a opekaj 6 minút, kým nie je hnedé, potom vmiešaj rímsky kmín, papriku, čili a soľ. Jedno vajce uvar natvrdo (9 minút).
steps.en: Dice the onions and pepper small and soften them in the oil for 6 minutes. Add the beef and fry for 6 minutes until browned, then stir in the cumin, paprika, chilli and salt. Hard-boil one egg for 9 minutes.

steps.sk: Plnku nechaj úplne vychladnúť – teplá by lístkové cesto rozmočila a roztopila v ňom maslo. Potom do nej vmiešaj nasekané vajce natvrdo, olivy nakrájané na krúžky a jarnú cibuľku.
steps.en: Let the filling cool completely; warm filling would melt the butter in the pastry. Then stir in the chopped hard-boiled egg, sliced olives and spring onions.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 200 °C. Lístkové cesto rozvaľkaj na hrúbku 3 mm a vykroj 12 kruhov s priemerom 12 cm. Na každý daj 2 lyžice plnky, okraje potri vodou, prelož na polmesiac a okraj pritlač vidličkou alebo zatoč.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Roll the pastry out to 3 mm and cut out 12 rounds of 12 cm. Put 2 tablespoons of filling on each, brush the edges with water, fold into a half-moon and seal with a fork or by twisting the edge.

steps.sk: Empanadas polož na plech s papierom, potri ich rozšľahaným druhým vajcom a peč 20 až 25 minút, kým nie sú nafúknuté a zlatohnedé. Plnka musí byť horúca, mäso je hotové pri 71 °C.
steps.en: Lay the empanadas on a lined tray, brush them with the second egg, beaten, and bake for 20 to 25 minutes until puffed and golden brown. The filling must be piping hot; the beef is done at 71 °C.

steps.sk: Nechaj ich 5 minút vychladnúť a podávaj so šalátom. Nepečené empanadas zamraz na tácke a peč ich priamo z mrazničky o 5 minút dlhšie.
steps.en: Let them cool for 5 minutes and serve with a salad. Freeze unbaked empanadas on a tray and bake them straight from frozen for 5 minutes longer.

title.sk: Brazílsky kurací strogonoff s ryžou
title.en: Strogonofe de frango: Brazilian chicken stroganoff

description.sk: Kuracie kocky s hubami v krémovej omáčke so smotanou, kečupom a horčicou, ako ju varia v Brazílii.
description.en: Chicken pieces and mushrooms in a creamy sauce of cream, ketchup and mustard, the way Brazilians make it.

steps.sk: Ryžu prepláchni a var s 500 ml vody a štipkou soli pod pokrievkou 15 minút. Mäso nakrájaj na kocky s hranou 2 cm, posoľ ho a okoreň. Cibuľu nakrájaj nadrobno a huby na plátky.
steps.en: Rinse the rice and cook it with 500 ml water and a pinch of salt, covered, for 15 minutes. Cut the chicken into 2 cm cubes and season with the salt and pepper. Finely chop the onion and slice the mushrooms.

steps.sk: Na veľkej panvici rozohrej olej s maslom na silnom ohni a mäso opekaj 5 minút, kým nie je zo všetkých strán zlatisté. Pridaj cibuľu a huby a opekaj ďalšie 4 minúty.
steps.en: Heat the oil and butter in a large frying pan over a high heat and fry the chicken for 5 minutes until golden on all sides. Add the onion and mushrooms and fry for another 4 minutes.

steps.sk: Pridaj cesnak, kečup a horčicu a miešaj minútu, potom prilej smotanu a 50 ml vody. Var na miernom ohni 3 minúty, kým omáčka nezhustne a mäso nemá vnútri 74 °C.
steps.en: Add the garlic, ketchup and mustard and stir for a minute, then pour in the cream and 50 ml water. Simmer gently for 3 minutes until the sauce thickens and the chicken reaches 74 °C inside.

steps.sk: Ochutnaj – omáčka má byť krémová, jemne sladká od kečupu a pikantná od horčice. Ak je príliš hustá, prilej trochu vody.
steps.en: Taste it: the sauce should be creamy, slightly sweet from the ketchup and sharp from the mustard. Loosen it with a little water if it is too thick.

steps.sk: Podávaj s ryžou; v Brazílii sa strogonoff posýpa chrumkavými zemiakovými slamkami. V chladničke vydrží 3 dni a výborne sa prehrieva.
steps.en: Serve with the rice; in Brazil it comes topped with crunchy potato sticks. It keeps in the fridge for 3 days and reheats very well.

title.sk: Gallo pinto – kostarická ryža s čiernou fazuľou
title.en: Gallo pinto: Costa Rican rice and black beans

description.sk: Ryža opečená s čiernou fazuľou, cibuľou, paprikou a koriandrom, s avokádom – na raňajky aj obed.
description.en: Rice fried with black beans, onion, pepper and coriander, with avocado; for breakfast or lunch.

steps.sk: Ryžu prepláchni a var s 500 ml vody a soľou pod pokrievkou 15 minút; potom ju rozprestri, aby vychladla – gallo pinto je najlepšie z ryže z predchádzajúceho dňa. Fazuľu sceď a 100 ml tekutiny z konzervy si nechaj.
steps.en: Rinse the rice and cook it with 500 ml water and the salt, covered, for 15 minutes, then spread it out to cool; gallo pinto is best made with day-old rice. Drain the beans, keeping 100 ml of the liquid from the can.

steps.sk: Cibuľu a papriku nakrájaj na drobné kocky a na oleji ich opekaj 5 minút do mäkka. Pridaj cesnak a rímsky kmín a miešaj minútu.
steps.en: Dice the onion and pepper small and fry them in the oil for 5 minutes until soft. Add the garlic and cumin and stir for a minute.

steps.sk: Pridaj fazuľu s tekutinou, sójovú omáčku a cukor a var 3 minúty, kým tekutina trochu nezhustne. Potom vmiešaj ryžu a opekaj ju 4 až 5 minút, kým nenasaje fazuľovú šťavu a nezafarbí sa.
steps.en: Add the beans with their liquid, the soy sauce and sugar and simmer for 3 minutes until slightly thickened. Then stir in the rice and fry for 4 to 5 minutes until it soaks up the bean juices and takes on their colour.

steps.sk: Vmiešaj nasekaný koriander a ochutnaj. Avokádo nakrájaj na plátky a pokvapkaj limetkou.
steps.en: Stir in the chopped coriander and taste. Slice the avocado and squeeze over some lime.

steps.sk: Podávaj s avokádom; v Kostarike sa gallo pinto je na raňajky s vajcom a kávou. V chladničke vydrží 4 dni a rýchlo sa prehreje na panvici.
steps.en: Serve with the avocado; in Costa Rica gallo pinto is breakfast, with an egg and coffee. It keeps in the fridge for 4 days and reheats quickly in a frying pan.

title.sk: Kurací koláč pod lístkovým cestom (pot pie)
title.en: Chicken pot pie with a puff pastry lid

description.sk: Krémová kuracia plnka so zeleninou a hubami, zapečená pod nadýchaným lístkovým cestom.
description.en: A creamy chicken, vegetable and mushroom filling baked under a puffed pastry lid.

steps.sk: Mäso nakrájaj na kocky s hranou 2 cm, mrkvu a zeler na kolieska, cibuľu nadrobno a huby na štvrtinky. Rúru predhrej na 200 °C.
steps.en: Cut the chicken into 2 cm cubes, slice the carrots and celery, chop the onion finely and quarter the mushrooms. Preheat the oven to 200 °C.

steps.sk: V širokom hrnci rozpusti maslo a zeleninu s hubami na ňom opekaj 6 minút do mäkka. Pridaj mäso a opekaj ďalšie 4 minúty, kým nezbelie.
steps.en: Melt the butter in a wide pan and cook the vegetables and mushrooms for 6 minutes until soft. Add the chicken and cook for another 4 minutes until white all over.

steps.sk: Posyp múkou a minútu miešaj, potom postupne prilievaj mlieko a 300 ml vody s rozdrobeným bujónom a stále miešaj, aby nevznikli hrudky. Pridaj tymian, soľ a korenie, var 5 minút do hustej omáčky a nakoniec vmiešaj hrášok.
steps.en: Sprinkle over the flour and stir for a minute, then gradually add the milk and 300 ml water with the crumbled stock cube, stirring all the time to avoid lumps. Add the thyme, salt and pepper, simmer for 5 minutes into a thick sauce and finally stir in the peas.

steps.sk: Plnku prelej do zapekacej misy a nechaj ju 10 minút vychladnúť, aby cesto pri pokladaní nezmäklo. Prikry ju plátom lístkového cesta, okraje pritlač k mise, v strede urob dva zárezy na paru a potri ho rozšľahaným vajcom.
steps.en: Pour the filling into a baking dish and let it cool for 10 minutes so the pastry does not go soggy as you lay it on. Cover with the puff pastry, press the edges onto the dish, cut two steam vents in the centre and brush with the beaten egg.

steps.sk: Peč 25 až 30 minút, kým cesto nie je vysoko nadýchané a sýto zlaté a plnka na okrajoch bublá. Kurča je hotové pri 74 °C.
steps.en: Bake for 25 to 30 minutes until the pastry is well risen and deep golden and the filling bubbles at the edges. The chicken is done at 74 °C.

steps.sk: Nechaj koláč 5 minút postáť a podávaj ho so zeleným šalátom. Plnku môžeš pripraviť deň vopred alebo zamraziť; cesto na ňu daj tesne pred pečením.
steps.en: Let the pie stand for 5 minutes and serve with a green salad. The filling can be made a day ahead or frozen; add the pastry just before baking.

title.sk: Americká fašírka v kečupovej glazúre
title.en: Glazed meatloaf with mashed potatoes

description.sk: Pečený mäsový bochník s lesklou sladkokyslou glazúrou, podávaný so zemiakovou kašou.
description.en: A baked meat loaf with a glossy sweet and tangy glaze, served with mashed potatoes.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 180 °C. Cibuľu nastrúhaj najemno, cesnak prelisuj a strúhanku namoč do 100 ml mlieka. Mäso zmiešaj s cibuľou, cesnakom, strúhankou, vajcami, horčicou, sójovou omáčkou, tymianom, ¾ lyžičky soli a korením len toľko, aby sa spojilo.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 180 °C. Finely grate the onion, crush the garlic and soak the breadcrumbs in 100 ml of the milk. Mix the meat with the onion, garlic, breadcrumbs, eggs, mustard, soy sauce, thyme, ¾ teaspoon of salt and the pepper just until combined.

steps.sk: Zmes vytvaruj na plechu s papierom do bochníka dlhého 25 cm a vysokého 7 cm – na plechu sa zapečie aj zo strán. Kečup zmiešaj s cukrom a octom a polovicou natri bochník.
steps.en: Shape the mixture into a loaf 25 cm long and 7 cm high on a lined baking tray; on a tray it browns on the sides too. Mix the ketchup with the sugar and vinegar and brush half over the loaf.

steps.sk: Peč 1 hodinu a po 40 minútach bochník natri zvyšnou glazúrou. Fašírka je hotová, keď má v strede 71 °C a vytekajúca šťava je číra.
steps.en: Bake for 1 hour, brushing on the rest of the glaze after 40 minutes. The meatloaf is done at 71 °C in the centre, with clear juices.

steps.sk: Medzitým zemiaky ošúp, nakrájaj a var v osolenej vode (½ lyžičky soli) 20 minút do mäkka. Sceď ich, pridaj maslo a 250 ml horúceho mlieka a roztlač na hladkú kašu.
steps.en: Meanwhile, peel and chop the potatoes and boil them in salted water (½ teaspoon of salt) for 20 minutes until tender. Drain, add the butter and 250 ml hot milk and mash until smooth.

steps.sk: Fašírku nechaj 10 minút odpočinúť, aby sa pri krájaní nerozpadla, a nakrájaj ju na plátky hrubé 2 cm. Podávaj s kašou a zeleninou. Studené plátky vydržia v chladničke 4 dni a sú výborné v sendviči.
steps.en: Rest the meatloaf for 10 minutes so it holds together, then cut it into 2 cm slices. Serve with the mash and vegetables. Cold slices keep in the fridge for 4 days and make a great sandwich.

title.sk: Sloppy joes – žemle s korenistým mletým mäsom
title.en: Sloppy joes

description.sk: Mleté hovädzie v sladkopikantnej paradajkovej omáčke navŕšené na opečenej žemli.
description.en: Minced beef in a sweet and tangy tomato sauce piled onto a toasted bun.

steps.sk: Cibuľu a papriku nakrájaj na drobné kocky a cesnak nadrobno. V širokej panvici rozohrej olej a zeleninu na ňom opekaj 5 minút do mäkka.
steps.en: Dice the onion and pepper small and chop the garlic finely. Heat the oil in a wide frying pan and fry the vegetables for 5 minutes until soft.

steps.sk: Pridaj mäso a opekaj ho 6 minút na silnom ohni, hrudky rozbíjaj vareškou na drobné kúsky, kým nie je hnedé. Prebytočný tuk zlej.
steps.en: Add the beef and fry over a high heat for 6 minutes, breaking it up into small crumbs with a spoon, until browned. Pour off any excess fat.

steps.sk: Vmiešaj kečup, pretlak, horčicu, cukor, sójovú omáčku, ocot, údenú papriku, štipku soli a 100 ml vody a var 10 minút, kým omáčka nezhustne a neobaľuje mäso. Hovädzie je hotové pri 71 °C.
steps.en: Stir in the ketchup, tomato paste, mustard, sugar, soy sauce, vinegar, smoked paprika, a pinch of salt and 100 ml water and simmer for 10 minutes until the sauce thickens and coats the meat. The beef is done at 71 °C.

steps.sk: Žemle rozkroj a opeč reznou plochou nadol na suchej panvici 1 minútu dozlatista. Kapustu nakrájaj na tenké rezance a kyslé uhorky na plátky.
steps.en: Split the buns and toast them cut side down in a dry pan for 1 minute until golden. Shred the cabbage finely and slice the pickles.

steps.sk: Na spodnú polovicu žemle navŕš mäso, pridaj uhorky a kapustu a prikry vrchnou polovicou. Sloppy joes sa jedia rukami a padajú – preto ten názov. Mäso vydrží v chladničke 3 dni.
steps.en: Pile the beef onto the bottom halves of the buns, add the pickles and cabbage and put the tops on. Sloppy joes are eaten with the hands and fall apart, hence the name. The beef keeps in the fridge for 3 days.

title.sk: Jambalaya s kuracím, klobásou a krevetami
title.en: Jambalaya with chicken, sausage and prawns

description.sk: Pikantná ryža z Louisiany varená v jednom hrnci s kuracím, údenou klobásou, krevetami a zeleninou.
description.en: Spicy Louisiana rice cooked in one pot with chicken, smoked sausage, prawns and vegetables.

steps.sk: Stehná nakrájaj na kocky s hranou 2,5 cm, klobásu na kolieska, cibuľu, papriky a zeler na kocky – v Louisiane sa táto trojica volá svätá trojica – a cesnak nadrobno. Ryžu prepláchni.
steps.en: Cut the thighs into 2.5 cm pieces and the sausage into rounds; dice the onion, peppers and celery, the trio Louisiana calls the holy trinity, and chop the garlic finely. Rinse the rice.

steps.sk: V širokom hrnci rozohrej olej a klobásu na ňom opekaj 3 minúty, kým nepustí tuk. Pridaj kuracie a opekaj 5 minút dozlatista, potom pridaj zeleninu a opekaj ďalších 5 minút.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a wide pot and fry the sausage for 3 minutes until it releases its fat. Add the chicken and brown it for 5 minutes, then add the vegetables and fry for another 5 minutes.

steps.sk: Vmiešaj cesnak a všetky koreniny, po minúte pridaj ryžu a miešaj, kým sa neobalí tukom. Pridaj paradajky, 700 ml vody s rozdrobeným bujónom, bobkové listy a soľ a priveď do varu.
steps.en: Stir in the garlic and all the spices, then after a minute add the rice and stir until coated in the fat. Add the tomatoes, 700 ml water with the crumbled stock cube, the bay leaves and salt and bring to the boil.

steps.sk: Prikry a var na najmenšom ohni 20 minút bez miešania. Potom na ryžu rozlož krevety, prikry a var ďalších 5 minút, kým krevety nezružovejú a ryža nevsiakne tekutinu.
steps.en: Cover and cook on the lowest heat for 20 minutes without stirring. Then scatter the prawns over the rice, cover and cook for 5 more minutes until the prawns are pink and the rice has absorbed the liquid.

steps.sk: Odstav a nechaj 5 minút prikryté dôjsť, potom premiešaj a posyp jarnou cibuľkou. Kuracie má vnútri 74 °C. Jambalaya vydrží v chladničke 3 dni; prehrievaj ju s lyžicou vody.
steps.en: Take off the heat and leave covered for 5 minutes, then stir and scatter with spring onions. The chicken should be 74 °C inside. Jambalaya keeps in the fridge for 3 days; reheat it with a spoonful of water.

title.sk: Krémová kukuričná polievka so zemiakmi a slaninou
title.en: Corn chowder with potatoes and bacon

description.sk: Hustá americká polievka z kukurice, zemiakov a mlieka s údenou slaninou a pažítkou.
description.en: A thick American soup of sweetcorn, potatoes and milk with smoky bacon and chives.

steps.sk: Slaninu nakrájaj na kocky, cibuľu a zeler nadrobno a zemiaky ošúp a nakrájaj na kocky s hranou 1,5 cm. Kukuricu sceď.
steps.en: Dice the bacon, chop the onion and celery finely and peel the potatoes and cut them into 1.5 cm cubes. Drain the sweetcorn.

steps.sk: V hrnci opraž slaninu 5 minút do chrumkava a polovicu vyber na posypanie. Na tuku speň cibuľu so zelerom 5 minút.
steps.en: Fry the bacon in a pot for 5 minutes until crisp and lift out half for the topping. Soften the onion and celery in the fat for 5 minutes.

steps.sk: Posyp múkou a miešaj minútu, potom prilej 500 ml vody s bujónom a mlieko a stále miešaj. Pridaj zemiaky, tymian, údenú papriku a korenie a var 15 minút, kým zemiaky nezmäknú.
steps.en: Sprinkle over the flour and stir for a minute, then pour in 500 ml water with the stock cube and the milk, stirring constantly. Add the potatoes, thyme, smoked paprika and pepper and simmer for 15 minutes until the potatoes are soft.

steps.sk: Pridaj kukuricu a smotanu a var 5 minút. Asi tretinu polievky rozmixuj ponorným mixérom a vráť späť – bude krémová, ale s kúskami. Dochuť štipkou soli.
steps.en: Add the sweetcorn and cream and simmer for 5 minutes. Blend about a third of the soup with a stick blender and stir it back in, so it is creamy but still chunky. Season with a pinch of salt.

steps.sk: Podávaj posypanú chrumkavou slaninou a pažítkou, s chlebom. Polievka vydrží v chladničke 3 dni; prehrievaj ju pomaly, aby sa mlieko nezrazilo.
steps.en: Serve topped with the crisp bacon and chives, with bread. The soup keeps in the fridge for 3 days; reheat it gently so the milk does not split.

title.sk: Cobb šalát s kuracím, vajcom, slaninou a avokádom
title.en: Cobb salad with chicken, egg, bacon and avocado

description.sk: Výdatný americký šalát s grilovaným kuracím, vajcom natvrdo, slaninou, avokádom a modrým syrom.
description.en: A hearty American salad of griddled chicken, hard-boiled egg, bacon, avocado and blue cheese.

steps.sk: Kuracie prsia posoľ ¼ lyžičky soli, okoreň a opeč na lyžičke oleja na stredne silnom ohni 5 až 6 minút z každej strany, kým nemajú vnútri 74 °C. Nechaj ich 5 minút odpočinúť a nakrájaj na kocky.
steps.en: Season the chicken breasts with ¼ teaspoon of salt and pepper and fry them in a teaspoon of the oil over a medium-high heat for 5 to 6 minutes on each side until 74 °C inside. Rest for 5 minutes, then dice.

steps.sk: Vajcia var 9 minút natvrdo, schlaď ich a nakrájaj na štvrtiny. Slaninu opraž na suchej panvici 6 minút do chrumkava a nalámaj na kúsky.
steps.en: Hard-boil the eggs for 9 minutes, cool them and cut into quarters. Fry the bacon in a dry pan for 6 minutes until crisp and break it into pieces.

steps.sk: Na dresing rozšľahaj zvyšný olej s octom, horčicou, medom, zvyšnou soľou a korením.
steps.en: For the dressing, whisk the remaining oil with the vinegar, mustard, honey, remaining salt and the pepper.

steps.sk: Šalát natrhaj na veľký tanier a navrch v pruhoch vedľa seba poukladaj kuracie, vajcia, slaninu, nakrájané avokádo, rozpolené rajčinky, rozdrobený syr a tenké plátky cibule – tak sa Cobb šalát tradične podáva.
steps.en: Tear the lettuce onto a large platter and arrange the chicken, eggs, bacon, sliced avocado, halved tomatoes, crumbled cheese and thinly sliced onion on top in rows side by side, the traditional way to serve a Cobb salad.

steps.sk: Posyp pažítkou a dresing pridaj až pri stole. Šalát je bohatý na bielkoviny a zasýti ako hlavné jedlo; zložky vydržia v chladničke 2 dni, avokádo krájaj vždy čerstvé.
steps.en: Scatter with chives and dress it at the table. The salad is packed with protein and filling enough for a main meal; the components keep in the fridge for 2 days, but always cut the avocado fresh.

title.sk: Cestoviny s kuracím po cajunsky
title.en: Cajun chicken pasta

description.sk: Pikantné kuracie prúžky v cajunskom korení s paprikou v krémovej omáčke s parmezánom.
description.en: Spicy Cajun-seasoned chicken strips and peppers in a creamy parmesan sauce.

steps.sk: Zmiešaj údenú papriku, cesnakový prášok, oregano, tymian, čili, ½ lyžičky soli a korenie – to je cajunská zmes. Mäso nakrájaj na prúžky a obaľ ho v polovici zmesi. Papriku nakrájaj na prúžky a cibuľu na polkolieska.
steps.en: Mix the smoked paprika, garlic powder, oregano, thyme, chilli powder, ½ teaspoon of salt and the pepper; this is your Cajun seasoning. Cut the chicken into strips and coat it in half the mix. Slice the pepper into strips and the onion into half-moons.

steps.sk: Cestoviny daj variť do vody so zvyšnou soľou podľa návodu na obale.
steps.en: Put the pasta on to cook in water with the remaining salt as the packet directs.

steps.sk: Na veľkej panvici rozohrej olej na silnom ohni a mäso opekaj 5 minút, kým nie je zvonka tmavé a vnútri nemá 74 °C. Vyber ho.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a large frying pan over a high heat and fry the chicken for 5 minutes until dark outside and 74 °C inside. Lift it out.

steps.sk: Na výpeku opekaj papriku a cibuľu 4 minúty, pridaj cesnak a zvyšnú zmes korenia a po 30 sekundách prilej smotanu. Var 3 minúty, kým omáčka nezhustne, potom vmiešaj parmezán.
steps.en: Fry the pepper and onion in the pan juices for 4 minutes, add the garlic and remaining seasoning and after 30 seconds pour in the cream. Simmer for 3 minutes until thickened, then stir in the parmesan.

steps.sk: Pridaj scedené cestoviny s 3 lyžicami vody z cestovín a mäso, premiešaj a posyp jarnou cibuľkou. Podávaj hneď; zvyšky vydržia 2 dni v chladničke.
steps.en: Add the drained pasta with 3 tablespoons of the pasta water and the chicken, toss and scatter with spring onions. Serve straight away; leftovers keep for 2 days in the fridge.

title.sk: Philly cheesesteak – bageta s hovädzím, cibuľou a syrom
title.en: Philly cheesesteak sandwich

description.sk: Tenké plátky hovädzieho s karamelizovanou cibuľou a paprikou pod roztopeným syrom v chrumkavej bagete.
description.en: Thin slices of beef with caramelised onion and pepper under melted cheese in a crusty roll.

steps.sk: Mäso daj na 30 minút do mrazničky, aby stuhlo, a potom ho nakrájaj naprieč vláknami na čo najtenšie plátky. Cibuľu nakrájaj na tenké polkolieska a papriku na prúžky.
steps.en: Freeze the beef for 30 minutes until firm, then slice it across the grain as thinly as you can. Slice the onion into thin half-moons and the pepper into strips.

steps.sk: Na veľkej panvici rozohrej polovicu oleja a cibuľu s paprikou opekaj na strednom ohni 8 minút, kým nezmäknú a nezačnú karamelizovať. Prelož ich na tanier.
steps.en: Heat half the oil in a large frying pan and cook the onion and pepper over a medium heat for 8 minutes until soft and starting to caramelise. Transfer to a plate.

steps.sk: Zvýš oheň na najsilnejší, pridaj zvyšný olej a mäso a opekaj ho 2 minúty, kým nestratí ružovú farbu; posoľ a okoreň. Vráť zeleninu, rozdeľ všetko na dve kôpky, na každú polož plátky syra a prikry na minútu, kým sa syr neroztopí.
steps.en: Turn the heat to the highest, add the rest of the oil and the beef and fry for 2 minutes until no longer pink; season with salt and pepper. Return the vegetables, divide everything into two heaps, lay the cheese slices on top and cover for a minute until melted.

steps.sk: Bagetky rozkroj pozdĺžne, ale nie úplne, potri ich vnútri maslom a opeč na panvici 1 minútu.
steps.en: Split the rolls lengthways without cutting all the way through, butter the insides and toast them in a pan for 1 minute.

steps.sk: Obracačkou nasuň kôpku mäsa so syrom do bagetky a hneď podávaj. Cheesesteak je najlepší horúci, kým sa syr ťahá.
steps.en: Slide each heap of beef and cheese into a roll with a spatula and serve straight away. A cheesesteak is best hot, while the cheese is still stringy.
